notes: Dreamina Seedance 2.5 animates a single still into a native 30-second clip at up to 720p (with native audio), extending one frame into continuous, coherent motion without drift or stitching. Token-based billing: tokens = (output_height * output_width * duration_seconds * 24) / 1024; charged $0.0214 per 1000 tokens at 480p and 720p (~$0.0234 per 1000 tokens at 1080p). Per-second (16:9): ~$0.2205/s at 480p, ~$0.4730/s at 720p, ~$1.164/s at 1080p (with audio). Input images are not billed. Duration: "auto" or "4" through "30". Resolutions: 480p, 720p (and 1080p per pricing). Aspect ratios: auto, 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Options: start frame (image_url), optional end frame (end_image_url), generate_audio (default true), seed, end_user_id (required for B2B access). Up to 50 multimodal reference inputs (images, video, audio, style) via reference-to-video endpoint. ~20% better prompt adherence vs prior generation. Endpoints: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video.
